# Micah 2 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** What sorrow awaits you who lie awake at night, plotting wickedness! You carry out your evil plans as soon as it gets light — simply because you have the power to do it.

**2** You want a certain field? You just take it. You see a house you like? You grab it. You cheat a man out of his property, stealing his family's inheritance.

**3** So this is what the LORD says: "I am planning disaster for you — a yoke you won't be able to remove from your necks. You won't be strutting around so proudly after that, because it will be a terrible time."

**4** On that day your enemies will make fun of you with this mocking song of despair: 'We are completely destroyed! God has changed our destiny! He has taken our land away from us and divided it among our captors.'

**5** Others will set the boundaries in your place. You will have no voice in the LORD's assembly.

**6** "Don't preach at us!" you say. "Don't preach about such things! Nothing bad is going to happen to us!"

**7** Should you talk that way, people of Israel? Is the LORD's patience really exhausted? Is this really His nature? Don't My words do good to those who live right?

**8** But My own people have turned against Me like an enemy! You strip the coats off the backs of those who trusted you, those minding their own business, veterans returning from battle.

**9** You have driven the women of My people out of their comfortable homes. You have robbed their children of My blessing forever.

**10** Get up and leave! This is not your place of rest anymore, because you have polluted it beyond all cure — it will destroy you!

**11** If a preacher full of hot air and lies came along and said, 'I'll preach to you about wine and beer!' — that's just the kind of prophet you people would want!

**12** "But someday, I will gather all of you who are left, O Jacob. I will bring the remnant of Israel together like sheep in a pen, like a flock in its pasture — what a noisy crowd it will be!"

**13** The One who breaks open the way will go up ahead of them. They will break through the gates and march out free. Their King will lead them — the LORD Himself will be at their head!

---
## PNEUMA's Meaning Notes

- **2:1-2**: They lie awake at night figuring out how to steal from the poor, then get up in the morning and do it. The chilling detail: they can do it 'because they have the power.' Unchecked power enables unchecked greed.

- **2:11**: Micah's sarcasm is razor-sharp: 'Want a prophet who preaches about wine and beer? That's your kind of preacher!' He's exposing people who only want to hear what makes them comfortable.

- **2:13**: After all the judgment, a sudden burst of hope — a Breaker who goes ahead, a King who leads, the LORD at the front. Even in Micah's darkest passages, rescue is never far away.

— PNEUMA
